design.summary: Add nullable urls.max_clicks. LinkService enforces it in ensure_active (click_count >= max_clicks -> 410). Redirect cache stores only unlimited links. init_db gains an additive migration that adds missing nullable columns. Idempotent replay of a deleted link raises LinkGoneError -> 410.

endpoints.response: 302, or 410 when the limit is reached

adr.title: ADR-003: Additive startup migration instead of a migration framework
adr.context: The service creates tables at startup and has no migration tool yet; v1 databases must keep working after upgrade.
adr.decision: Add only nullable columns automatically and refuse anything else with an error that demands a reviewed migration.
adr.consequences: Safe, zero-downtime upgrade for additive changes. Destructive or NOT NULL changes still need Alembic (planned).

design.test_strategy: Integration tests for limit enforcement, cache bypass, validation, the replay bug, and migration of a hand-built v1 database; existing suite as regression.

decisions.rationale: Keeps metadata, redirect and cache paths consistent
